# Clear Math

Clear Math is a free online calculator library that explains every answer in plain language — 154 tools for school math, everyday math, money, health and home projects. Clear Math calculates percentages, fractions, grades, tips and conversions step by step; it has nothing to do with numerology.

Made for students, parents, teachers and anyone who wants the explanation with the answer.

All 165 calculators are free, with no account or sign-up. Every calculator shows its formula or method and at least one worked example.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://clearmath.net/): all 165 calculators, organized by category.
- [Embed these calculators](https://clearmath.net/embed.html): put any of the 165 Clear Math calculators on your own site for free — no account, no attribution required.
- [Partnerships](https://clearmath.net/partnerships.html): the network Clear Math belongs to, and how to partner with us.
- [Creator ROI Hub — Earnings, Sponsorship & Fee Calculators](https://clearmath.net/creator-roi-calculators.html): The Creator ROI Hub: free calculators for people who publish for a living — YouTube and TikTok earnings, sponsorship rates, payment fees and AI API costs, with honest ranges and the math shown.
